sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive leadership is taking hold as Energy commands the market, but early cracks are emerging in Healthcare despite broad gains.

Market strength is concentrated in a defensive cohort, with only 3 of 11 sectors holding all-green status across all measured timeframes: Energy, Healthcare, and Consumer Defensive. Energy remains the indisputable leader, holding the top spot on momentum (0.867) and maintaining its position as the sole sustained leader across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons. 

Rotations favor traditional safety, with Consumer Defensive gaining ground to reach rank 3 while Utilities notched a modest 1-spot improvement. Meanwhile, cyclical and growth pockets are fading into the bottom tiers, anchored by Communication Services (momentum 0.233) and Consumer Cyclical (rank 11, momentum 0.367).

## Strength
- **Narrow all-green breadth:** Only 3 of 11 groups are positive across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD: Energy (0.87), Healthcare (0.83), and Consumer Defensive (0.80).
- **Dominant leadership:** Energy is the only sector demonstrating sustained strength across 1-, 3-, and 6-month rank windows, leading all sectors with a 0.867 momentum score.
- **Top-tier concentration:** Consumer Defensive (0.800) and Technology (0.550) round out the upper ranks alongside Energy and Healthcare, while Financials sit at 0.517.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Defensive gainers:** Consumer Defensive climbed +1 spot over the last 5 sessions to rank 3 (momentum 0.80), and Utilities edged up +1 spot to rank 9 (momentum 0.37).
- **Communication Services slides:** Dropped -1 spot to rank 10 over 5 sessions, cementing its spot as the absolute momentum laggard at 0.233.
- **Lagging baseline:** Real Estate (0.300), Industrials (0.317), Basic Materials (0.350), and Consumer Cyclical (0.367, rank 11) remain pinned in the bottom momentum tier with zero 5-day rank improvement.

## Divergences
- **Healthcare fading:** Despite an all-green profile and high momentum of 0.833 (rank 4 YTD), Healthcare slipped -1 spot over the last 5 sessions, flashing an early-warning divergence of slowing relative strength.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive consumer, energy, and insurance groups continue to anchor market leadership, while cyclical industrials, tech, and precious metals experience steep short-term deteriorations.

Breadth remains concentrated with 33 of 144 industry groups maintaining all-green profiles across all tracked timeframes. Strength is heavily clustered in traditional cash-flow-heavy pockets: Department Stores, Insurance - Reinsurance, and Oil & Gas Integrated and Refining & Marketing continue to sustain top-tier positioning across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons. Staples and regulated segments like Household & Personal Products and Utilities - Regulated Water are also absorbing rotation, posting double-digit rank gains over the past five sessions.

Conversely, a sharp unwind is hitting capital goods, metals, and tech-adjacent groups. Metal Fabrication, Electronic Components, and Engineering & Construction led the weekly drop, each shedding 30 or more rank spots. Simultaneously, early leadership is softening in select healthcare and software areas, while housing-related cyclicals are displaying early rank rebounds off depressed momentum baselines.

## Strength
- **All-Green Breadth:** 33 of 144 industries are positive across all time horizons, headlined by Department Stores (momentum 0.89), REIT - Hotel & Motel (momentum 0.87), Insurance - Reinsurance (momentum 0.87), and Oil & Gas Integrated (momentum 0.85).
- **Sustained Leadership:** Energy, consumer staples, and healthcare distributions hold long-term dominance, with Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (rank 1 YTD, momentum 0.850) and Oil & Gas Integrated (rank 4 YTD, momentum 0.854) maintaining top-36 ranks across 1-, 3-, and 6-month metrics.
- **Defensive Anchors:** Healthcare Plans (0.81 momentum), Beverages - Brewers (0.84 momentum), and Beverages - Non-Alcoholic (0.79 momentum) remain fully positive across the week, month, quarter, half, and year-to-date.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top 5-Day Rank Gainers:** Lumber & Wood Production jumped +19 spots to rank 67 (momentum 0.57), followed by Waste Management (+17 spots to rank 65, momentum 0.74) and Department Stores (+16 spots to rank 43, momentum 0.89).
- **Severe Short-Term Drawdowns:** Metal Fabrication plunged -42 spots to rank 86 (momentum 0.22), Electronic Components dropped -35 spots to rank 56 (momentum 0.27), and Engineering & Construction fell -31 spots to rank 80 (momentum 0.18).
- **Momentum Extremes:** Department Stores (0.888) and REIT - Hotel & Motel (0.871) lead all groups in momentum, while Advertising Agencies (0.055, rank 144 YTD), Uranium (0.064, rank 133 YTD), and Solar (0.072, rank 140 YTD) anchor the bottom.

## Divergences
- **Fading High-Momentum Groups:** Shell Companies (momentum 0.67) dropped -11 spots over the past 5 sessions, while Diagnostics & Research (momentum 0.74) slid -5 spots, signaling near-term exhaustion despite high absolute momentum.
- **Emerging Low-Momentum Rebounds:** Housing-adjacent industries are climbing the ranks ahead of their momentum scores, including Home Improvement Retail (+7 spots, momentum 0.49), Residential Construction (+7 spots, momentum 0.40), and Building Materials (+5 spots, momentum 0.32).
- **Metals Under Pressure:** Both precious and industrial metals are deteriorating simultaneously, with Other Industrial Metals & Mining (-26 spots), Silver (-26 spots, rank 77), and Gold (-23 spots, rank 100) all sliding sharply over the last week.
